[Gentlemen](/organisation/258),[^1]
I enclose the slip you have been so good as to forward to me - with a few corrections, to which I would wish to add that I have been the author of ‘the [Kings of England](/book/6),’ and of ‘Landmarks of History’ [‘] [Ancient](/book/14)’, ‘[Middle Ages](/book/16)’ and ‘[Modern](/book/28)’ being a compendium of Universal History for young people. I should prefer no statement being made as to the application of the proceeds of my publications

your obt servt

C M Yonge


[^1]: The biographical dictionary referred to here was probably Men of the Time (7th ed.

London: Routledge 1868), whose entry on CMY appears to correspond with this letter.
